query: Set up a targets pipeline for the readmission project: raw parquet in data/raw, cleaning, cohort, 3 models, and a Quarto report at the end. Write _targets.R.
why does tar_make() rebuild model_fit every time even when nothing changed? _targets.R attached. suspect a Sys.time() somewhere
Use dynamic branching over 14 hospital sites in our targets pipeline and pick a storage format for the per-site brms fits (~300MB each).
Our analysis is 9 numbered R scripts run by hand. I want a reproducible R pipeline that only reruns what changed. tarchetypes + quarto. help
tar_quarto keeps re-rendering the manuscript even though analysis targets are up to date - debug the dependency
Review our _targets.R for hidden external state: it reads a CSV via a hard-coded path inside a function and uses set.seed globally.
Add a sensitivity-analysis branch to the existing targets pipeline (tar_map over 4 exclusion definitions) without invalidating the primary model.
tar_outdated() lists 30 targets after I updated renv. Explain what invalidated and whether it's safe to run just the report target.
targets pipeline errors: 'Error running targets::tar_make() ... object cohort_df not found' in target table1. fix the graph
convert the analysis to targets with crew for parallel workers on our slurm cluster; keep file inputs tracked with tar_file
Build a Fabric Data Factory pipeline that copies the nightly EHR extract into the lakehouse and triggers the cleaning notebook.
Create a Snakemake workflow for our RNA-seq alignment and counting steps with per-sample rules.
Write a reproducible implementation plan for the readmission analysis: units of work, SAP references, and tests, before any code.
Refactor scripts/02_clean.R to tidyverse with explicit join relationships; no pipeline changes.
Profile the brms model fitting step; it takes 6 hours per site and I want before/after timings.
Validate the new raw encounters extract against the cohort spec before anything runs: types, duplicates, missingness.
Set up the structure for a new Quarto analysis notebook for the readmission project with documented sections.
Create a new R package for our pipeline helper functions with roxygen and testthat.
Set up renv for this project and pin package versions; nothing else.
Write a reactive marimo notebook that reruns downstream cells when the cohort filter changes.
